Subject: Intro + demo — exploring Redwood for our ML inference stack

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the email thread earlier — wanted to pull this out and get a quick sync on next steps. Arbor is evaluating inference options for our feature store and real-time scoring pipeline. Our VP of Engineering (Patrick O'Leary) and CTO (Maya Singh) would like a concise exec intro followed by a 45 minute demo focused on latency/cost and deployment modes (esp. VPC/private).

Constraints:
- Maya is only available after 4:30pm PDT on Thu-Fri this week.
- We prefer a short (10–12 minute) sponsor intro before the demo.

Can you and your team propose 2 possible windows? Also include who from your side will do the exec intro and who will lead the technical demo. If you have a one-pager or current SOC/Security summary, please attach — procurement will want that.

Best,
Patrick
VP of Engineering
Arbor Inc

Attachment: arbor-rfp-notes.pdf (summary of evaluation criteria)

Subject: Re: Intro + demo — exploring Redwood for our ML inference stack

Patrick — thanks, and really appreciate the clarity on availability. Looping in Ben (solutions lead) and Marissa (customer success / exec brief).

Two proposed windows that fit our exec/engineering alignment:
- Wed May 6, 2026 — 4:45pm–5:30pm PDT (would start with a 10-minute sponsor intro, then 40-minute technical demo + Q&A)
- Thu May 7, 2026 — 5:30pm–6:15pm PDT (same format)

If those look tight for Maya, we can also do a shorter 30-minute compact session on Wed 6 at 5:15pm PDT. Please confirm which you prefer and whether you want Marissa or me to give the sponsor intro. Ben would run the demo; he can cover Dedicated and Private deployment patterns plus a short cost/latency comparison.

Security doc: we have a short SOC2 highlight and platform-security one-pager. I attached an internal deck draft and a sponsor briefing plan for the exec segment.

Next steps: once you confirm a slot, we'll send a calendar invite and a brief agenda (10min exec, 35–40min demo, 10–15min deep-dive/offline follow-up).

Thanks — Soojin
